title: ai utilities
description: Ai Chatbot Tools in a Minecraft Mod. You can ask a Chatbot questions, summarize big texts or translate sentences using an AI and completely free!
body:
This Mod adds AI Utilities to Minecraft

With advanced Chatbot support, summarization of big texts and translation of words or sentences, you can ask for ideas, tips and so much more!

You can use an completely free AI for everything you want.

!!WiFi connection needed!!


1. Generate



Ask the AI a question: /ai generate "<prompt>"

For example: /ai generate "How are you today?"



2. Summarize



Let the AI summarize a text: /ai summarize "<text>" <max_length>



3. translate



Let the AI translate a Sentence: /ai translate "<text>" <lang>

For example: /ai trranslate "Hi, how are you?" de
